overview: Research task graph to produce a frozen-input FY2024 report on NVIDIA (NVDA) covering executive summary, three statements/gaps, valuation/limitation, risks, and investment conclusion with explicit citations.
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Search and retrieve frozen snapshot evidence for NVIDIA FY2024: filings (10-K, 10-Q), financial statements, market data, analyst reports, and news. Use only pre-frozen evidence sources. Output ranked evidence candidates with citation-ready records.
tasks.expected_output: List of evidence records with evidence_id, source, date, content snippet, and relevance score.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis on evidence from task_001: compute three-statement view, ratios, trends, peer comparison, valuation model (e.g., DCF or multiples), risk identification, and investment thesis. Explicitly label critical claims with evidence_ids. Output structured claims, tables, valuation model, and risk factors.
tasks.expected_output: JSON object with sections: 'executive_summary_claims', 'three_statements_or_gaps', 'valuation_or_limitation', 'risks', 'investment_conclusion', each containing claim text, evidence_ids, and supporting artifacts (tables, charts).

tasks.description: Assemble the final report in Markdown, HTML, and JSON formats using claims and evidence from task_002 and raw evidence from task_001. Include executive summary, three statements/gaps, valuation/limitation, risks, investment conclusion. Attach required charts and compliance disclosure. Ensure every material claim has a body citation.
tasks.expected_output: Three files: report.md, report.html, report.json with embedded citations and evidence references.

tasks.description: Verify the final report from task_003: check that all critical claims have explicit evidence_id citations, no unsupported numbers, coverage of all required sections, and consistency with frozen snapshot evidence. If violations found, output revision brief. Otherwise approve.
tasks.expected_output: Verification pass/fail with detailed feedback and revision instructions if needed.
